summary: WorkflowStub.cancel() throws IllegalStateException instead of the documented WorkflowNotFoundException when attempting to cancel a non-existent workflow, creating a mismatch between documented and actual behavior.
userImpact: Users attempting to cancel non-existent workflows receive an unexpected exception type, potentially breaking error handling logic that expects WorkflowNotFoundException.
rootCause: Internal check in WorkflowStubImpl.checkStarted() throws IllegalStateException for null workflowId, but API documentation promises WorkflowNotFoundException.
proposedFix: Document the actual exception behavior rather than changing it to avoid breaking changes.
keyQuote: The resolution here is likely to be documenting the exception rather than changing it.
